Segment is 西气东输二线九高线（九江-新建-高安）— note MEE's Yangtze-crossing completion acceptance (t20161222_369425.htm, found via search, not in harvest pool) covers a DIFFERENT object: the MAIN EAST-SECTION TRUNK's river-crossing tunnel at Ruichang (瑞昌市, under Jiujiang prefecture), 2587.47m, commissioned 2011-06 — geographically in the same prefecture but not the 210.32km Jiujiang-Gao'an BRANCH; not used as a source for this row to avoid conflating trunk and branch (aggregate-vs-segment rule). resolutions.researcher_notes: Checked a cross-shard lead (Gao'an-named rows P5861/P4778 filed a reciprocal WEP2-vs-Phase-I misattribution __REDUNDANCY__) against this row. Fetched the 2013 Jiangxi provincial gas plan PDF cited in that lead (pdftotext -layout, not url_verifier's extractor, which misses this CJK PDF's text layer) and independently confirmed two dated facts in it: (1) 川气东送 (Sichuan-East Gas Transmission) began supplying Jiangxi gas 2010-06, feeding the province's 'Phase I' 870km network (6 named trunks: 九江-南昌/九江-沙河/九江-景德镇/南昌-丰城/高安-新余/丰城-抚州 + 田南-上高支线); (2) 西气东输二线 (WEP2) did not begin supplying Jiangxi gas until 2011-09, feeding a separate 98km 'Phase II' network (吉安/赣州/安义 sections + 宜春/萍乡). P4794's own StartYear1=2010-08 predates WEP2's actual first gas delivery to Jiangxi by ~13 months, and instead lines up almost immediately after the Sichuan-East/Phase-I supply-start date (2010-06), while the row's FuelSource is staged as 'West-East Gas Pipeline' and its wiki section header names it 西气东输二线九高线 (explicitly a WEP2 branch codename). Same tension as P4793: neither '九江-高安' / '九江-新建-高安' nor '九高线' appears verbatim among the plan document's named Phase I trunks, though 九江-南昌 (Jiujiang-Nanchang) IS one of the six and runs through the same Jiujiang-to-Xinjian-area corridor this row's own start segment covers, which is at least geographically consistent with a Phase I attribution. Flagging for human adjudication on FuelSource/parent-network attribution — NOT recommending any value change or row action. Not filing as __REDUNDANCY__ against a specific sibling PID (unlike P5861/P4778) because no other shard/payload in this run names a candidate duplicate PID for this corridor.
